chunks: From him, from al-Nadr, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who killed his mother, does he inherit her? He said, 'I heard my father saying, 'Any man of kin who kills his relative, he does not inherit him.''

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: Does a son who kills his mother inherit her estate according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific application of the 'barrier of killing' (حاجز القتل) in Shia jurisprudence, where a son who kills his mother is excluded from her inheritance. It highlights the scholarly consensus that the killer's right to inherit is extinguished due to the moral and legal weight of the homicide, reinforcing the principle that the killer cannot benefit from the victim's estate.
